ch1_cosmic_whatif.concept: Deep Space, Cosmic Mysteries & What If Science Scenarios
ch1_cosmic_whatif.visual_style_prompt: cinematic space photography, ultra detailed nebulae and planets, dramatic volumetric lighting, deep blue and violet palette, photorealistic, 8k, IMAX quality
sub_themes: Black holes and their strange physics
What if a planet or a star suddenly vanished
Exoplanets and the search for alien life
The Fermi paradox and the great cosmic silence
Neutron stars, pulsars and magnetars
The Sun, solar storms and the life cycle of stars
Mars colonization and terraforming scenarios
Time dilation, relativity and light-speed thought experiments
Dark matter, dark energy and the universe's missing mass
The Big Bang, the early universe and the cosmic microwave background
Moons of Jupiter and Saturn such as Europa, Titan and Enceladus
Asteroid impacts, comets and planetary defense
Rogue planets, hypervelocity stars and other bizarre cosmic objects
What if humans lived on, or travelled through, an extreme world or a wormhole
Voyager probes, lonely spacecraft and humanity's farthest explorers
Galaxy collisions, the Milky Way and the Local Group
The human body in space and surviving extreme environments
Multiverse theories, simulation theory and mind-bending cosmic scale comparisons
hook_styles: Open with one impossible-sounding cosmic fact with a precise number, then say you will explain it by the end
Open with a direct 'What if...' that drops the viewer into the disaster at second one, and hold back the outcome
Open with a claim that contradicts what every textbook says, stated as flat fact
Open in the middle of the event (a star is already dying, a signal is already arriving) with no setup
Open with a chilling cosmic detail that sounds like horror, then promise the real explanation is stranger
visual_moods: vivid purple and magenta nebula glow
cold blue starlight with deep black shadows
fiery orange and red stellar surfaces
ghostly teal auroras and ionized gas
stark high-contrast black and white astrophotography with a single warm light source
golden sunrise light grazing across alien landscapes
proven_examples: Saturn's Ring Is Made of Alien Ocean Water
The Sunless Planet That Radiates Ghost Light
This Star Was Kicked Out Of Our Galaxy
weak_examples: The Invisible Doorway That Could Destroy Earth (vague)
three separate Voyager videos in a row (repetitive)

ch2_dark_history.concept: Dark History, Ancient Civilizations & Unsolved Historical Mysteries
ch2_dark_history.visual_style_prompt: dark cinematic historical painting style, ancient ruins, torchlit atmosphere, moody chiaroscuro lighting, desaturated earthy tones, ultra detailed, 8k
sub_themes: Lost civilizations that vanished without a clear explanation
Ancient engineering mysteries such as the pyramids, the Antikythera mechanism and Gobekli Tepe
Vanished expeditions and unsolved disappearances of the past
Medieval plagues, famines and survival under brutal conditions
Secret societies, forbidden orders and covert history
Strange archaeological discoveries that challenge the textbooks
Famous historical hoaxes and forgeries
Ancient warfare, siege tactics and ruthless strategies
Ghost ships, mysterious shipwrecks and sea enigmas
Forgotten empires and rulers erased from history
Cursed artifacts and legends with real historical roots
Ancient medicine, strange cures and burial customs
Historical cold cases told respectfully and factually
Undeciphered scripts and mysterious ancient manuscripts
Bizarre historical customs, trials, punishments and superstitions
Espionage, assassinations and political conspiracies of the past
Natural disasters that changed history such as Pompeii, Thera and Tambora
The Bronze Age collapse and the mystery of the Sea Peoples
hook_styles: Open with a date, a place and the single impossible fact: 'In 1307, a fleet of ... vanished and nobody ever...'
Open with a precise number that makes the claim unbelievable (weights, years, body counts) and withhold why
Open by flatly contradicting the standard history lesson

foggy dawn over desolate ruins in muted grey-green tones
sepia-toned aged parchment and oil painting texture
stormy seas and dark skies with dramatic lightning
dusty golden desert light over crumbling monuments
candlelit medieval interiors with deep red and brown tones
